title: Twisting Branch
summary: A Wood Woad club. Summoned Woads can carry a magical variant.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple one-handed Light and Dippable club. 5 ft melee. Hit for 1d4 Bludgeoning plus Strength.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed strips the Dexterity AC bonus, gives Disadvantage on Wisdom saves and prevents spending Reactions. Help clears it.
fields.Magic Club: The ordinary dropped club has no Magic Club rider. The summoned version has a 3d4 Bludgeoning rider. The linked source reports the damage is nonmagical despite the text, can apply to any melee attack and triggers twice if dual wielded.
fields.Acquisition: Wood Woads in the Decrepit Sanctuary. A summoned Wood Woad can carry the enchanted version.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
